Name: AT - Pokemon Secret Base Furniture for Alternative Textures
Author: zaoux
Description:
Adds furniture from Pokémon Gen 3 Secret Bases into Stardew Valley using Alternative Textures!

There are two versions to download - the original colour palette from Pokémon,
and an alternative colour palette based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91802318]Grapeponta's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367?tab=posts]Vibrant Pastral Recolour[/url].

Most assets are directly from the video games, but multiple assets are hand drawn to fit Stardew Valley's dimensions, so if you're doing your
own recolours, please make sure to give credit!
